lines.trans: What do you mean, Isabelle is unavailable?
She has a fashion show and costume fittings.
I stayed in Paris specially for her!
She charms me, then she snubs me.
Sacha, do not be so paranoid.
I do not need Adjani for my movie.
There are other great actresses.
Wait, I am going to call her right away.
Hello Isabelle? It is Andréa Martel.
Sacha Hartman would really like to see you.
Would you be free tomorrow morning at the office?
Perfect, see you tomorrow at eleven o'clock!
You see, Sacha? It is settled.
She really agreed to see me?
Yes, she has been trying to reach you for two days.
Alright, then I will be there tomorrow.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

meanings.en: au contraire = on the contrary; au revoir = goodbye

examples.text: Il y a une autre Clémentine?
L'un à midi, l'autre à deux heures.
examples.trans: One at noon, the other at two.

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: elle a besoin d'aide = she needs help

examples.trans: Are you going to your desk?

meanings.note: comment ça va? = how are you?

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
Je suis seule depuis trois mois.
examples.trans: I've been on my own for three months.

meanings.en: for (a length of time, still going on)
meanings.note: with the present: je suis là depuis trois mois
un défilé de mode = a fashion show

examples.text: Je ne fais pas de défilés.
examples.trans: I do not do fashion shows.

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.
examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

examples.text: Tu l'as dit sans faire exprès.
examples.trans: You said it without meaning to.

examples.text: Il ne l'a pas fait exprès.
examples.trans: He didn't do it on purpose.

meanings.note: faire exprès = to do on purpose; sans faire exprès = by accident, without meaning to
quelle heure est-il? = what time is it?
à tout à l'heure = see you later

joindre.gloss: to join, to reach, to contact

meanings.en: to reach, to contact; to join, to attach

examples.trans: She is trying to reach you.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Elle est libre dans trois semaines.

meanings.note: at liberty; not 'free of charge' (that's gratuit)
du matin = a.m., in the morning
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
J'ai fait un an de socio, puis j'ai arrêté.
examples.trans: I did a year of sociology, then I stopped.
He works, then he goes home.
I have an appointment with the doctor.

meanings.note: avoir rendez-vous avec = to have an appointment with

examples.text: Ne restez pas là à ne rien faire!
examples.trans: Don't just stay there doing nothing!

meanings.en: rester là à + infinitive = to stay there doing

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

meanings.en: to snub, to look down upon

examples.text: Elle me séduit puis me snobe.
examples.trans: She charms me then snubs me.

examples.text: Tu es très douée pour séduire les gens.
examples.trans: You're very good at charming people.

meanings.en: to charm, to win over, to seduce

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
je vous rappelle = I'll call you back
il y a = there is / there are
j'y pense = I think about it
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
